markdown: **Activate—Hide the Horror** <actions string="" /> 10 minutes ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per year;   **Effect** You hide the _vile remnant_ somewhere that, in time, it is likely to be found. For the following four weeks, _the vile remnant_’s evil seeps into the surrounding landscape, expanding its influence at a rate of 200 feet per day until it reaches its maximum emanation of 5,600 feet after 28 days. It continues to influence this area for another three weeks before going dormant— it must be recovered and rehidden later once this activation recharges to begin the cycle again. While the remnant’s influence is active, any sapient creature that sleeps in the area experiences unsettling dreams of being stalked by monsters they can never quite see or evade. A creature that doesn’t worship an unholy deity who experiences these dreams must succeed at a DC 23 Will save each time they rest to avoid awakening [fatigued](/Conditions.aspx?ID=73). On a critical failure, the creature awakens [stupefied](/Conditions.aspx?ID=94) 1 as well; this condition remains until removed or until they are no longer fatigued, whichever comes first. Creatures who worship an unholy deity or follow a despicable philosophy are immune to this effect. Any skill checks made by such creatures when performing rituals performed in the affected area gain a +1 item bonus, and _nightmare_ spells cast by them within the region have their save DCs increased by 1.
name: 10 minutes (manipulate)

At the end of a minute of concentration, you know the direction and approximate distance to a nearby _soulheart_ (this is typically, but not always, the closest _soulheart_). This activation doesn’t discern between _soulhearts_ whose locations you already know about or not, and as such, Activating this power while you or a nearby ally carry a _soulheart_ isn’t particularly helpful. If no _soulhearts_ can be detected, you know this, but the activation’s daily use is still consumed.

The spirits of four runelords of gluttony (Kaliphesta, Atharend, Aethusa, and Goparlis) briefly appear in spaces within 60 feet of you. Each living creature adjacent to at least one of the spirits takes 4d6 void damage per adjacent spirit, to a maximum of 16d6 void damage if they are adjacent to all four spirits. Each target receives a basic Fortitude save against the damage, against the higher of your class DC or spell DC, but Xanderghul, the Runelord of Pride, treats the result of his saving throw as one degree of success worse.

 You gain temporary Hit Points equal to half the damage a single creature takes from this effect; calculate these temporary Hit Points using the creature that took the most damage. These temporary Hit Points last 1 minute.

markdown: **Activate—Expand Lodge** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You set the lodge on the ground, where it expands into a structure 40 feet long, 20 feet wide, and 20 feet high. The lodge is well-built, with a sturdy stone foundation, thick timber walls, and a peaked roof shingled with scraps of bark. The lodge’s ground floor contains a dining hall on one end and a sitting area with a hearth surrounded by comfortable chairs on the other. A staircase connects the hall to the lodge’s second floor, which consists of four simply furnished bedrooms. The lodge is decorated throughout with taxidermic beasts native to the Dimension of Dreams. If a creature inside the lodge spends 10 minutes studying these trophies, they gain a +3 item bonus to the next skill check they make in the next 24 hours to Recall Knowledge about any creature with the dream trait. Furnishings or decorations removed from the lodge disappear but return to their original locations inside the lodge with the next activation. You can [Dismiss](/Actions.aspx?ID=2311) the dream hunter’s lodge to return it to its miniature form.

**Source** [YOU CAN PLAY WITH JIMOTHY NOW](/Sources.aspx?ID=369) --- Jimothy [Strides](/Actions.aspx?ID=2305) up to his Speed. During this movement, he can try to move through the space of one enemy and take a small object from them. Jimothy attempts a [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) check against the enemy's Reflex DC as soon as he tries to enter its space.
**Critical Success** Jimothy moves through the enemy's space and takes an object of negligible Bulk from the enemy that is worn but not closely guarded (such as a pouch). Jimothy must have a free hand to take the object. If he doesn't have enough Speed to move all the way through its space, Jimothy gets the same effect as a failure.
**Success** As critical success, but Jimothy treats the squares in the enemy’s space as [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2586) (every 5 feet costs 10 feet of movement).
**Failure** Jimothy’s movement ends, and he triggers reactions as if he had moved out of the square he started in.
**Critical Failure** As failure, but Jimothy also then falls [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=88).

markdown:
**Activate—Chimera's Visage** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))     **Effect** You shift _Chimera's Claw_ to change its primary head, allowing access to that head's weapon traits and secondary effect. 

**Horned Dragon Head** The dragon head's horn deals piercing damage. In this mode, the warhammer has the [sweep](/Traits.aspx?ID=708) and [versatile S](/Traits.aspx?ID=724) weapon traits. Each time you damage a creature with this weapon, the dragon's flaring nostrils snort out a small cloud of cloying, acrid gas that deals an additional 2 [persistent poison damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=86) in addition to the weapon's normal damage. 

**Screaming Cat Head** The screaming cat's brutal teeth deal slashing damage. In this mode, the warhammer has the [backstabber](/Traits.aspx?ID=544) and [versatile B](/Traits.aspx?ID=724) weapon traits. Tiny rubies inset into the eyes of the weapon's screaming cat face ignite as bright-red pinpoints, distracting foes with traces of crimson light as the weapon shifts and moves in combat. This grants you a +2 item bonus to [Feint](/Actions.aspx?ID=2390) against a target you damaged with _Chimera's Claw_ in the previous round. 

**Snorting Goat Head** The snorting goat's curled horns and heavy brow deal bludgeoning damage. In this mode, the warhammer has the [shove](/Traits.aspx?ID=694) and [versatile P](/Traits.aspx?ID=724) weapon traits. The goat head's long horns function as a [levered crowbar](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2718).

If the creature struck by the critical hit is slain by its damage, the blade impales its victim. Black, oily energy like wet smoke pours from the victim's eyes and flows to the ebon sword, desiccating the corpse in an instant as all of its liquid seeps into the Lifedrinker, leaving the body a dried-out husk. 

The first time this happens when its wielder is at least 10th level, _Meloth's Lifedrinker's_ _+1 weapon potency_ rune permanently becomes a _+2 weapon potency_ rune. The first time this happens when its wielder is at least 12th level, Meloth's Lifedrinker's _striking_ rune permanently becomes a _greater striking_ rune. The first time this happens when its wielder is at least 16th level, Meloth's Lifedrinker's _+2 weapon potency_	rune permanently becomes a _+3 weapon potency_ rune. And the first time this happens when its wielder is at least 19th level, _Meloth's Lifedrinker's_ _greater striking_ rune permanently becomes a _major striking_ rune.
